scope: Root clarifications for System-only mapping validation; no overall product scope decision or live UserValidated authorization.
gamepadMissingAxisStatus: Rejected; Invalid in proposal table describes future formal MappingStatus, not this result enum.
metadataCollectionRules: All non-null catalog entries independently check canonical path and declared ValueKind, even if both invalid. Duplicate grouping includes only valid canonical paths. Stage 4 collects then deduplicates/sorts all diagnostics.
Stage 5 duplicate grouping includes only valid mapped paths; invalid paths produce per-axis InvalidMappingPath with empty diagnostic Path.

Stage 6 missing axis or Button/Other skips metadata validation only for that axis. Axis metadata validates type/format/size independently; missing preprocess skips that axis preprocessing fields, not other metadata.

When preprocess exists, collect unknown clamp and all nonfinite fields. Range comparisons run only on their relevant finite operands; clamp range additionally requires a declared non-None clamp; normalize range additionally requires Normalize=true. Unrelated invalid floats do not suppress a validly evaluable range diagnostic.

ControlTypeFullName additionally rejects comma, forward/backslash, equals, and colon to reject assembly qualification or path/value syntax. It does not prove actual CLR type or device ownership; backend must report actual AxisControl excluding ButtonControl.
NormalizeZero<NormalizeMax remains an explicit conservative candidate policy; it is not a claim that Unity rejects all other metadata. No normalization or raw values are computed.

sdkReadOnlyEvidence.limits: Root read installed metadata/Preprocess/raw-reading sections and complete NormalizeProcessor; no SDK copied, no Unity runtime or thin adapter executed. Enum conversion remains explicit future adapter work.
